description.value: The MAQ Pub occupies the lower level of the historic Maquinna Hotel in Tofino and has been a local gathering spot since the 1950s, originally frequented by fishermen and loggers and nicknamed 'The Dirty MAQ'. Today it draws surfers, tourists, and hospitality workers with a rotating lineup of live music, karaoke nights, DJs, and dancing. It is part of the MAQ Hotel complex, which also includes The MAQ Cafe and The Bear Bierhaus.

address.value: 120 First St, Tofino, British Columbia, V0R 2Z0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the venue at 120 First St, Tofino inside the MAQ Hotel, with phone +1 800-665-3199; OSM had no address or phone to cross-check. The OSM name 'Maquinna Pub' differs from the website's consistent branding 'The MAQ Pub', so the website value is used per rule 12. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, food menu, Wi-Fi) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags; the venue is a nightlife bar focused on live music, karaoke, and pool with no food service described.
concerns: OSM name is 'Maquinna Pub'; website consistently uses 'The MAQ Pub' — website value used, OSM name flagged.
OSM opening_hours (Su-Tu 18:00-24:00, Th-Sa 18:00-01:00) conflict with hours on the website; not included per rules but may indicate stale OSM data.
No food menu mentioned anywhere on the website — venue appears to be a drinks and entertainment bar only.
Address and phone were absent from OSM; values sourced from website only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The MAQ Pub is a legitimate evening bar in a popular cycling destination, but the website describes no food service, no cycling amenities, and no daytime service — limiting its practical value for touring cyclists. The MAQ Cafe (a sibling business at the same address) may be a stronger candidate for the directory.
enrichment_extras.notes: The MAQ Hotel complex also includes The MAQ Cafe, which may better serve touring cyclists and should be evaluated as a separate candidate.
